flush_hint: Manually run one distillation: extract the latest turn of the current session into the enabled categories (the "min turn tokens" threshold does not apply; the request returns as soon as it is queued — progress is shown in the status bar "memory distillation" queue state, and category contents refresh when done).
clear_confirm: Clear the content of "{name}"? The category is kept; only its content is emptied (unlike "Delete").
records_note: Compression only writes into the session snapshot (summary + retained segment); the compression time is not recorded. The texts below are the summaries already persisted in the current session's snapshot.
records_empty: No compression record for the current session (compression not triggered yet, or no snapshot).
records_no_session: No active session, cannot read compression records.
